Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF)

Required findings: Significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.) AND unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit (e.g., biceps, triceps weakness), reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver), or unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity without concordant objective physical exam findings

MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that is caused by ANY of the following: herniated disc(s) (retained disc material or a recurrent disc herniation), synovial cyst or arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, or osteophytes

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks; provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks; or epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery

Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders) AND documentation of nicotine-free status (never-smoker OR refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and/or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Radiculopathy (TOC: S9.1.1)

Required findings: ANY of the following: upper/lower extremity weakness, numbness, or pain; fine motor dysfunction (buttoning, handwriting, clumsiness of hands); gait disturbance; new-onset bowel or bladder dysfunction; or frequent falls

ANY of the following: grip and release test, ataxic gait, hyperreflexia, Hoffmann sign, Babinski sign, tandem walking test demonstrating ataxia, inverted brachial radial reflex, increased muscle tone or spasticity, clonus, or myelopathic hand

MRI/CT shows findings that are concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that are caused by EITHER of the following: cervical spinal cord compression or cervical spinal stenosis
N/A (Conservative management trial not explicitly required in this subsection)
N/A (General criteria not explicitly required in this subsection)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Myelopathy (TOC: S9.1.2)

Non-Indications: Presence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Failure to document nicotine-free status (smoker, smokeless tobacco user, or nicotine replacement therapy user within 6 weeks of surgery) or failure to provide objective cotinine testing within normal range for those who have quit

Failure to demonstrate less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least two of the specified conservative management options (medications, exercise, or injections) for the required duration (6 weeks) for Radiculopathy

Absence of concordant objective imaging findings (MRI/CT) showing neural structure compression or spinal cord compression/stenosis at the requested level(s) that matches symptoms and physical exam findings
Absence of required physical exam findings (e.g., no dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit, reflex changes, or specific myelopathic signs) for the claimed condition
Important criteria & exceptions: Conservative management requirements (medications, exercise, injections) are waived if contraindicated
Nicotine-free status must be validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab
For Radiculopathy, conservative care must include at least TWO of the three listed options (medications, exercise, injections) for six weeks
Imaging must show compression caused by specific etiologies (herniated disc, cysts, stenosis, osteophytes) for Radiculopathy or cord compression/stenosis for Myelopathy
Documentation required: Plain x-rays of the cervical spine including flexion/extension lateral views
MRI or CT report showing neural structure compression or spinal cord compression/stenosis concordant with symptoms and physical exam

Records of conservative management including prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, NSAIDs, provider-directed exercise program, or epidural steroid injections/selective nerve root blocks for at least six weeks
Objective cotinine testing results (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within normal range, or documentation of never-smoker status
Documentation of absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders
